subject: PROPOSED cinematography R&D and A/B pilot package for review with Ziggy
body:
Claude, Ziggy explicitly requested this cinematography R&D proposal and reusable pilot package for CFA Nova and you to review WITH HIM. Both files are copied unchanged and hash-verified. This is a distinct proposal, not the already acknowledged Flow review notice 98220a40.

Cinematography includes lighting AND camera work. Candidate pool: Gemini Master, Kimi, Qwen, DeepSeek and Nova; no candidate is assigned or ranked. Compare identical written-package responses before recommending a lead or justified small team; Ziggy reviews the recommendation before assignment or new generation. Gemini Master’s stated preferences are distinguished from her established coordination duties and earned grades.

Pilot: exact A/B paths/hashes and critique, prior actual prompt, 720p/nominal-rate caveat and scoped reference gaps. Pass A preserves source camera/action and isolates motivated practical lighting while retaining blue night. Pass B separately proposes camera direction and declares whether regeneration would be required; it cannot silently change Pass A’s preservation contract.

Light R&D is bounded to the three already supplied cab, sword and futuristic-bike examples with exact links and archived still evidence in the package. Full motion remains unreviewed; current web opens failed. Visual observation, creator-documented recipe and technique hypothesis remain separate. No candidate activation, pipeline adoption, upload, generation, purchase or paid run is requested by this proposal. Please review these documents with Ziggy; preserve proposed status.
